transcript: Speaker A: If you're over 50 and think you'll never speak English, you're wrong. You just need to practice every day, and that's exactly what I'm here for. I'm Loora, your AI English tutor. With me, you can practice anytime, anywhere, just like you would with a real person. I'll chat with you, provide instant feedback on your pronunciation, and help you improve with every conversation. It's fast, easy, and pressure-free. You don't have to worry about making mistakes because I'll guide you through them. Let's practice together every day, and you'll see how quickly your English improves.
